notes.title: Polar Star - The Revisit Update
notes.content:
Polar Star is out and on sale!

Polar Star is on a 10% discount until September, 23!

 CHANGELOG:[previewyoutube="cT6e5dsUwuY;full"][/previewyoutube]FEATURES
Now you can revisit any day separately and without tutorials.

RESET button now resets your personal best score, locks you out of arcade mode and resets your story mode progress.  
FIXES
Fixed a typo in day 2.

Fixed a bug where day 1 dialogue would play in the ARCADE mode.

notes.title: Polar Star - A Week Away
notes.content:
Polar Star is releasing in just A WEEK - September, 16th![previewyoutube="jJi8Zx5Z6nY;full"][/previewyoutube]Make it to the top or die trying in a 30 to 60 minute story campaign, and after that go EVEN HIGHER in an endless ARCADE mode where you can pick what items to play with.

!IMPORTANT!This week is the last chance for you to play the demo - after the game's release it will be removed from Steam, so if you want to play it for free - now is the best moment to do so.

notes.title: Polar Star, now stutter-free
notes.content:
Update 0.3.3 brings Polar Star to Godot 4.4! 

This update focuses on improving performance of the game, especially getting rid of the stutters caused by shader compilation. 

Also save file can self-heal now: if a variable is missing from the file, the game will fill it up automatically, so nothing in your settings or save will break.

But the update has a new feature too: the death screen now shows your personal best score in the custom endless mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602301/67d68ae71d08332c8c8b618431faa1e526a5dde4.png

The full game is actively being worked on, and the development is going pretty smoothly right now, so stay tuned for future updates. This is not a goodbye, as our long conversation has only just begun...
